newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Khong Guan suspension extended again.
newsitem.headline: Khong Guan suspension extended again.

text.p: Malaysian property developer and confectionery maker Khong Guan Holdings Bhd has been granted a five-day extension for the suspension of its shares by the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange (KLSE).
The KLSE announced this in a statement on Tuesday.
The suspension is to last from December 3 to December 9, the statement said.
The exchange had said in November that Khong Guan was preparing to announce the acquisition of certain assets. No further details were given.
In September, Khong Guan said it was acquiring seven hotels and a piece of land for 384 million ringgit.
Khong Guan stock closed at 21.90 ringgit on November 8.
